name: sonarqube
description: SonarQube for IDE analysis during agentic development: runs Sonar's own IDE engine (SLOOP) locally on every file Claude edits and blocks the session from ending while touched files still have secrets or high-severity findings; reads SonarQube Server or Cloud through `sonar api`. Requires Node 22.12+; run /sonarqube:setup once to install the engine.

min_blocking_severity.title: Block the session on
min_blocking_severity.description: Which local findings stop a session from ending, on lines the session changed: "high" (BLOCKER, CRITICAL/HIGH), "blocker" (BLOCKER only), "medium" (also MAJOR/MEDIUM), or "secrets-only". Secrets in touched files block under every setting.

per_edit_feedback.title: Report issues after each edit
per_edit_feedback.description: After every Edit/Write, analyze the edited file with the warm local daemon and show Claude the MAJOR/MEDIUM+ issues and secrets on the changed lines. Never blocks; skipped while the daemon is still starting.

daemon_idle_minutes.title: Daemon idle timeout (minutes)
daemon_idle_minutes.description: The per-project analysis daemon (a JVM, roughly 0.5-1 GB) exits after this many idle minutes.
